gui.odysseymap.setting.smart_deathpoints:
Requires Deathpoints. Enhances one marker per death and follows falling loot.
Shows loot time (normally 5 minutes). Turns black on loss, then deletes after the configured delay (default 5 minutes).
Nearby confirmed recovery removes it sooner.
keepInventory and indefinite graves normally hide timers; actual drops enable them.
Exact lifetimes and pickup names need the mod on the server.
